1: # Implementation Tasks: Scaffold Plugin Foundation
2: 
3: ## 1. Plugin Bootstrap
4: 
5: - [ ] 1.1 Create root plugin file `cwp-wordpress-starter-plugin.php` with proper WordPress headers
6:   - Plugin Name, Description, Version, Author, Author URI, License, Text Domain, Domain Path
7:   - Define `CWP_PLUGIN_VERSION` and `CWP_PLUGIN_DIR` constants
8:   - Include bootstrap initialization function
9:   - **Validation**: File exists, passes WordPress plugin validation
10: 
11: - [ ] 1.2 Create main plugin class `admin/php/class-plugin.php` in `CWP\StarterPlugin` namespace
12:   - Constructor accepts optional dependencies
13:   - Registers hooks for admin and public asset enqueueing
14:   - Handles text domain loading for translations
15:   - Methods: `__construct()`, `enqueue_admin_assets()`, `enqueue_public_assets()`
16:   - **Validation**: Class is properly namespaced, instantiable, and hooks register correctly
17: 
18: - [ ] 1.3 Create utility hooks file `admin/php/Hooks.php` with placeholder hook functions
19:   - `cwp_register_scripts_styles()` - Hooks for asset enqueueing
20:   - Example action/filter hooks for extension
21:   - **Validation**: Functions follow CWP naming convention, PHPDoc included
22: 
23: ## 2. Directory Structure
24: 
25: - [ ] 2.1 Create admin structure directories
26:   - `/admin` - Backend PHP logic
27:   - `/admin/hooks` - Organized hook registrations
28:   - **Validation**: Directories exist and are navigable
29: 
30: - [ ] 2.2 Create public structure directories
31:   - `/public` - Frontend PHP logic (shortcodes, templates)
32:   - **Validation**: Directories exist and are navigable
33: 
34: - [ ] 2.3 Create source asset directories
35:   - `/src/admin` - Admin TypeScript/CSS
36:   - `/src/public` - Public TypeScript/CSS with components subdirectory
37:   - `/src/public/components` - Reusable JavaScript components
38:   - `/src/shared` - Shared utilities
39:   - **Validation**: Directories exist and are empty/have placeholder files
40: 
41: - [ ] 2.4 Create assets output directory (initially empty)
42:   - `/assets` - Will hold built JavaScript and CSS
43:   - Add `.gitkeep` to ensure directory tracking
44:   - **Validation**: Directory exists and is tracked by git
45: 
46: ## 3. TypeScript & JavaScript Source Files
47: 
48: - [ ] 3.1 Create TypeScript configuration file `tsconfig.json`
49:   - Target ES2020, module ESNext
50:   - Strict mode enabled
51:   - Include `/src` files, exclude `/node_modules`, `/assets`, `/vendor`
52:   - **Validation**: File is valid JSON, TypeScript can compile with it
53: 
54: - [ ] 3.2 Create admin entry point `/src/admin/index.ts`
55:   - Import admin stylesheet
56:   - Basic console log or initialization code for demo
57:   - **Validation**: File compiles without errors
58: 
59: - [ ] 3.3 Create admin stylesheet `/src/admin/styles.scss`
60:   - Basic SCSS structure with variables for colors, spacing
61:   - Example utility classes
62:   - **Validation**: File processes without SCSS errors
63: 
64: - [ ] 3.4 Create public entry point `/src/public/index.ts`
65:   - Import public stylesheet
66:   - Basic initialization code
67:   - **Validation**: File compiles without errors
68: 
69: - [ ] 3.5 Create public stylesheet `/src/public/styles.scss`
70:   - Basic SCSS structure
71:   - Example component styles
72:   - **Validation**: File processes without SCSS errors
73: 
74: - [ ] 3.6 Create shared utilities `/src/shared/utils.ts` and `/src/shared/constants.ts`
75:   - Common utility functions and constants
76:   - Importable by both admin and public modules
77:   - **Validation**: Files are importable without errors
78: 
79: ## 4. Vite Build Configuration
80: 
81: - [ ] 4.1 Create `vite.config.ts` file
82:   - Define build entry points: `/src/admin/index.ts`, `/src/public/index.ts`
83:   - Configure output to `/assets` with `.js` and `.css` files
84:   - Set library mode (not application)
85:   - **Validation**: File is TypeScript valid and recognized by Vite
86: 
87: - [ ] 4.2 Configure SCSS/PostCSS processing
88:   - Use `sass` and `postcss` loaders
89:   - Include Autoprefixer plugin
90:   - **Validation**: `vite build` processes `.scss` files to `.css`
91: 
92: - [ ] 4.3 Create `.postcssrc.json` configuration
93:   - Configure Autoprefixer for browser targets
94:   - Target browser support (e.g., last 2 versions)
95:   - **Validation**: PostCSS processes and prefixes CSS correctly
96: 
97: - [ ] 4.4 Add build scripts to `package.json`
98:   - `pnpm build`: Runs `vite build`
99:   - `pnpm build:watch`: Runs `vite build --watch`
100:   - **Validation**: Both scripts execute without errors
101: 
102: ## 5. PHP Code Standards Configuration
103: 
104: - [ ] 5.1 Create `phpcs.xml` configuration file
105:   - Use WordPress-VIP-Go standard
106:   - Exclude `/vendor`, `/node_modules`, `/assets`, `/tests`, `/docs`
107:   - Include paths: `/includes`, `/admin`, `/public`
108:   - Enforce `cwp_` prefix on functions and hooks
109:   - **Validation**: PHPCS runs without errors, finds real issues in sample PHP
110: 
111: - [ ] 5.2 Add PHPCS check script to `package.json`
112:   - `pnpm lint:php`: Runs `phpcs`
113:   - **Validation**: Script executes and reports correct coding standard
114: 
115: - [ ] 5.3 Create sample PHP file to validate standards
116:   - `/admin/hooks/enqueue.php`: Demonstrates proper naming conventions
117:   - Uses `cwp_` prefix for action hooks
118:   - Includes proper docblocks
119:   - **Validation**: PHPCS validates file without errors
120: 
121: ## 6. Asset Enqueueing
122: 
123: - [ ] 6.1 Create admin asset enqueueing in class-based Plugin
124:   - Method: `enqueue_admin_assets()`
125:   - Registers and enqueues `/assets/admin.js` with deps: `['wp-i18n', 'wp-element', 'jquery']`
126:   - Registers and enqueues `/assets/admin.css` with deps: `['wp-common']`
127:   - Uses version from `PLUGIN_VERSION` constant
128:   - **Validation**: Admin assets load in WordPress admin with correct handles
129: 
130: - [ ] 6.2 Create public asset enqueueing in class-based Plugin
131:   - Method: `enqueue_public_assets()`
132:   - Registers and enqueues `/assets/public.js`
133:   - Registers and enqueues `/assets/public.css`
134:   - Uses version from `PLUGIN_VERSION` constant
135:   - Skips enqueueing on admin pages
136:   - **Validation**: Public assets load on frontend
137: 
138: - [ ] 6.3 Add hook registration in Plugin constructor
139:   - `add_action('admin_enqueue_scripts', [$this, 'enqueue_admin_assets'])`
140:   - `add_action('wp_enqueue_scripts', [$this, 'enqueue_public_assets'])`
141:   - **Validation**: Hooks fire at correct priority and time
142: 
143: ## 7. ESLint & Code Formatting
144: 
145: - [ ] 7.1 Create `.eslintrc.json` configuration
146:   - Use `@wordpress/eslint-plugin` with TypeScript parser
147:   - Target browser and WordPress environments
148:   - Include `/src` files, exclude `/assets`, `/vendor`
149:   - Enable strict rule set
150:   - **Validation**: ESLint runs and enforces WordPress standards
151: 
152: - [ ] 7.2 Create `.prettierrc.json` configuration
153:   - Line width: 100
154:   - Tab width: 2
155:   - Trailing comma: 'es5'
156:   - Single quotes: true
157:   - Semicolons: true
158:   - **Validation**: Prettier formats consistently
159: 
160: - [ ] 7.3 Add lint scripts to `package.json`
161:   - `pnpm lint:js`: Runs `eslint src --ext .ts,.tsx`
162:   - `pnpm format:js`: Runs `prettier --write src`
163:   - `pnpm lint:styles`: Runs `stylelint src --fix`
164:   - **Validation**: All scripts execute successfully
165: 
166: - [ ] 7.4 Create `.stylelintrc.json` configuration
167:   - Use `stylelint-config-standard-scss`
168:   - Target SCSS files
169:   - **Validation**: Stylelint processes SCSS without errors
170: 
171: ## 8. Composer & PHP Dependencies
172: 
173: - [ ] 8.1 Create `composer.json` file
174:   - Package name: `cwp/starter-plugin`
175:   - Require: `php ^7.4`, `squizlabs/php_codesniffer`, `wp-coding-standards/wpcs`
176:   - PSR-4 autoloading for `CWP\StarterPlugin\` namespace
177:   - **Validation**: Composer file is valid JSON, composer install works
178: 
179: - [ ] 8.2 Create `composer.lock` file (after running composer install)
180:   - All PHP dependencies locked to specific versions
181:   - **Validation**: File is generated and tracked in version control
182: 
183: - [ ] 8.3 Create `.gitignore` for composer artifacts
184:   - Include `/vendor` directory
185:   - Exclude `/composer.lock` from .gitignore (commit it for reproducible installs)
186:   - **Validation**: Composer vendor directory is not tracked
187: 
188: - [ ] 8.4 Add composer scripts to `composer.json`
189:   - `composer lint`: Runs PHPCS
190:   - **Validation**: Script is callable and executes PHPCS
191: 
192: ## 9. Testing Structure (Templates)
193: 
194: - [ ] 9.1 Create `phpunit.xml.dist` configuration
195:   - Bootstrap file: `tests/bootstrap.php` (loads WordPress test suite)
196:   - Test directory: `tests/unit`
197:   - Exclude `/vendor`, `/node_modules`, `/assets`
198:   - **Validation**: File is valid XML, PHPUnit recognizes it
199: 
200: - [ ] 9.2 Create `jest.config.js` configuration
201:   - Preset: `@wordpress/jest-preset-default`
202:   - Test environment: 'jsdom' (for DOM-based tests)
203:   - Module map aliases for TypeScript path imports
204:   - **Validation**: Jest recognizes config, can run test discovery
205: 
206: - [ ] 9.3 Create test directory structure
207:   - `/tests` directory (root level)
208:   - `/tests/unit` directory (for PHPUnit tests)
209:   - `/src/__tests__` directories (for Jest tests alongside source)
210:   - **Validation**: Directories exist and match conventions
211: 
212: - [ ] 9.4 Add test scripts to `package.json`
213:   - `pnpm test`: Runs `jest`
214:   - `pnpm test:watch`: Runs `jest --watch`
215:   - `pnpm test:php`: Runs `phpunit`
216:   - **Validation**: All scripts are callable (even if tests don't exist yet)
217: 
218: ## 10. GitHub Actions CI
219: 
220: - [ ] 10.1 Create GitHub Actions workflow
221:   - Create `.github/workflows/lint.yml` with:
222:     - Trigger: push, pull_request to main branch
223:     - Jobs for PHP validation (PHPCS)
224:     - Jobs for JavaScript validation (ESLint)
225:     - Format checking (Prettier)
226:     - TypeScript compilation check
227:   - **Validation**: Workflow file is valid YAML
228: 
229: - [ ] 10.2 Add job matrix for multiple environments
230:   - PHP versions: 7.4, 8.0, 8.1+ (WordPress compatibility)
231:   - Node.js LTS versions
232:   - Parallel execution for speed
233:   - **Validation**: Workflow runs on multiple versions successfully
234: 
235: - [ ] 10.3 Test workflow execution
236:   - Push to feature branch
237:   - Verify GitHub Actions runs automatically
238:   - Check that failures are reported clearly
239:   - **Validation**: Workflow appears in Actions tab, runs successfully
240:
